promotion_refusal.erratum: Issue #131: this positive control admitted six unverified proof claims as promoted. Under evidence_acceptance the same test admits the record only after an owner fixture ledger verifies each claim, keeps every refusal reason with verified receipts present, and adds refusals for an unverified obligation and for a dissenting owner outcome.

evidence_acceptance.rule: EvidenceRecord values are submitter claims kept as visible, unverified provenance. Only VerifiedEvidence receipts, minted at admission from the EvidenceVerifier the library owner supplied, support tested or promoted; incoming receipts are discarded and re-derived, and load re-establishes every persisted receipt through the loading owner's verifier.

evidence_acceptance.non_claims: The owner fixture ledger in the tests stands for independently recorded checks; it is not a proof checker. The library ships no verifier, checks no Lean, Verus or test artifact, and proves no Rust-to-model refinement; D14's NO-GO is unchanged.
